jobs.title: Senior Project Manager, HR Systems Transformation
jobs.description:
**Senior Program Manager, HR Systems Transformation**  
Contract: 6–12 months, extension possible | Remote with occasional travel | Senior, executive-facing

**Overview**  
A large global enterprise is transforming a core HR platform, and the change reaches nearly every part of the organization. The initiative is underway, carries significant investment, and is closely watched by the company's most senior leaders. We're looking for a senior program leader to take charge of it. You'll set direction, earn executive confidence, and hold a wide network of teams accountable as the work moves across connected systems.

**What You'll Lead**

* Take ownership of an HR systems transformation already in progress and set a clear path to completion
* Establish and run program governance: steering committee schedule, decision frameworks, and escalation paths
* Be the trusted voice to senior executives on status, risks, trade-offs, and the decisions you need from them
* Prepare short executive briefings that show what's working, what's at risk, and the recommended next step
* Drive accountability across teams you don't directly manage, and settle competing priorities
* Work across HR, payroll, IT, and business teams to support integrations with connected systems, keeping dependencies visible and on track
* Guide the program through a stage-gated, PMI-aligned lifecycle and its gate reviews
* Partner with HR business partners on change impact so stakeholders stay confident in the rollout
* Bring leadership and structure to the existing project team

**Required Qualifications**

* Senior program or project leadership on complex, enterprise-scale transformations
* Proven executive presence: you've briefed and influenced senior executives and kept their confidence under pressure
* Experience establishing governance and running steering committees
* Track record of driving accountability across functions through influence rather than authority
* Experience working across multiple teams to support system integrations and manage the dependencies between them
* Delivery experience in waterfall or stage-gated environments
* Ability to travel occasionally

**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* HR system implementation experience (PeopleSoft preferred; Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or Oracle HCM also valued)
* Experience with HR, payroll, training, or onboarding integrations
* HR data migration or reclassification experience
* Organizational change management experience
* Exposure to Agile delivery

**Tools & Environment**  
PeopleSoft HCM and the systems connected to it. Stage-gated, PMI-aligned lifecycle, with onboarding on the client's methodology. Remote collaboration across a large, matrixed organization.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**  
You lead from the front. You walk into a large, complex organization, learn it fast, and become the person executives turn to for a straight answer. You're comfortable telling senior leaders what they need to hear, laying out hard trade-offs, and asking for decisions. You build trust across teams without formal authority and keep everyone focused on the same outcome. You see this as a business transformation, not a technical rollout. Strong performance may lead to an extension or follow-on work.

jobs.title: Senior Product Operations Lead & Program Manager - Content Experience Innovation
jobs.description:
At Netflix, our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.

  
  

**Our Team**

  

The Content Experience Innovation (CEI) product team is leading the strategy to shape how Netflix members discover and engage with new content types. This includes 0 to 1 areas such as Live events, Podcasts, Creator content, Games discovery and more. Our work spans all platforms (TV/living room, mobile, tablet, and web), and includes features and experiences across discovery/browse, player, profiles, and new surfaces. We sit at the intersection of Product, Tech, Content, and Production, and act as the connective tissue that keeps our product surface in step with our content strategy.

  
  

This role sits on the Configurations team within Content Experience Innovation (CEI), connecting CEI with the broader business through configurable, high-velocity capabilities that scale globally and for every content type. We are looking for a Senior Product Operations Lead/Program Manager to join our team.

The Role

You’ll own the product operations backbone of the team including the ways of working, operating rhythms, portfolio visibility, and systems that make a fast-moving product organization more efficient and effective. You’ll also be responsible for aligning those operating rhythms to those of our partner teams across Product + Tech, working in lock step with the Prod Ops partners Member Experience and Commerce product orgs to ensure we all work together toward a cohesive end member experience. You’ll also flex into Program Management to drive critical innovation programs across the team to bring our product vision to life.

**What You Will Do.** ..

  
  

* Strengthen how the team works by defining, documenting, and maintaining the ways of working and standards that keep product development running smoothly.
* Run the team's core operating cadences, including planning, OKRs, and QBRs while coordinating inputs, timelines, and deliverables, and turning them into clear, actionable and decision-ready readouts for leadership.
* Own portfolio-level operations: manage intake and prioritization, maintain the roadmap and launch calendar, and give the team and its partners a clear view of what's in flight, what's coming, and what's at risk.
* Drive stakeholder communication and alignment by keeping partners across Product, Engineering, and cross-functional teams informed of key dates, changes, and dependencies, and maintain a single, trusted source of truth for plans, decisions, and outcomes.
* Design and build scalable systems, workflows, and tooling that reduce manual effort and make the team faster, leveraging AI and automation where it creates efficiency.
* Identify operational opportunity areas across the product development lifecycle, and drive improvements that increase quality, efficiency, and productivity.
* Partner with New Content Exploration and various Product and Tech teams on initiatives within their innovation roadmaps.
* Lead complex programs that cut across product areas that transform the way we work, managing high degrees of change.
* Partner with senior leadership to shape the business vision and opportunity of transformation efforts.
  

  

**What You’ll Bring**

  

* 10+ years of Product Operations, Product or Program Management, Business Operations, or related experience in a product-driven organization.
* A track record of designing and scaling operational processes, rhythms, and systems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, with a high degree of autonomy.
* Fluency with operating cadences such as planning, OKRs, and QBRs, and the ability to turn messy inputs into clean, decision-ready outputs.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to connect the dots between projects and programs to ladder up to company and team goals
* Demonstrated ability to build tooling and workflows that create leverage, including practical use of AI and automation to improve efficiency.
* A sharp eye for operational opportunity areas across a product development lifecycle, and the judgment to prioritize the improvements that matter most.
* Strong cross-functional partnering skills across Product, Engineering, TPM, Design, and non-technical teams.
* Fluency with product/ops tooling (e.g., Jira, Airtable) and comfort adapting shared frameworks to what a team actually needs.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication, including clear updates for leadership.
* Content discovery, merchandising performance management, or recommendation systems domain experience preferred.
  

  
  
Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $0.00 - $0.00. This compensation range will vary based on location.

**Please note:** This position is **dedicated** **to internal PMO initiatives and operational programs**. The role does not directly support customers, participate in client-facing activities, generate billable utilization, or manage external project engagements.

Blue Yonder’s PMO team is seeking a Project Manager to drive operational excellence and innovation within our North America Professional Services organization. This role bridges project management and PMO operations to empower our Professional Services Project Managers and scale our delivery capabilities.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Support and Lead PMO Initiatives:** Own the execution of discrete PMO improvement projects from process standardization to operational efficiency initiatives. Support the broader PMO team in rolling out best practices, governance frameworks, and delivery excellence programs across North America projects. Track initiative progress, manage stakeholder communication, and report on outcomes.

Provide timely, high-quality operational support to help PMs focus on delivery.

**Education & Background**

* Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management is required. Bonus if the degree is from a leading SCM program or institution.

* Proficiency with project management platforms (Smartsheet, Jira, Asana, or similar) and CRM systems (Salesforce preferred).
* Advanced Excel skills and comfort with data analysis, visualization, and reporting.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT Enterprise, Copilot, or similar) and interest in building AI-powered workflows and agents.
* Basic understanding of APIs, no-code/low-code automation platforms (Zapier, Make, etc.), and knowledge management systems.

**Skills & Attributes**

* Exceptional attention to detail with strong organizational and project coordination skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to influence across levels.
* Proactive and entrepreneurial mindset—comfort with ambiguity and driven to create new solutions using modern tools.

We are seeking a highly analytical and execution-oriented Senior Project Manager to support a large-scale Federal Health IT program modernizing the Electronic Health Record (EHR) for the Indian Health Service (IHS).
  
The Project Manager will lead complex, cross-functional project activities across a highly matrixed and multi-vendor environment. This is an opportunity for a hands-on project manager who enjoys bringing order to complexity and improving how work gets done.

* Partner with stakeholders to develop mitigation strategies and drive corrective actions.

jobs.description:
AHEAD builds platforms for digital business. By weaving together advances in cloud infrastructure, automation and analytics, and software delivery, we help enterprises deliver on the promise of digital transformation.

At AHEAD, we prioritize creating a culture of belonging, where all perspectives and voices are represented, valued, respected, and heard. We create spaces to empower everyone to speak up, make change, and drive the culture at AHEAD.

We are an equal opportunity employer, and do not discriminate based on an individual's race, national origin, color, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, marital status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law, whether actual or perceived.

***We embrace all candidates that will contribute to the diversification and enrichment of ideas and perspectives at AHEAD.***

The **Technical Program Manager** leads complex, multi-workstream technology programs that span related projects and teams across the lifecycle of an engagement. This role is accountable for working with cross-functional teams on aligning customer outcomes, solution strategy, commercial commitments, integrated delivery plans, and execution across AHEAD.

The Technical Program Manager operates at the intersection of Pre-Sales, Sales, Delivery, Practices, Resource Management, Finance, partners, and customer leadership. They help shape opportunities, establish the program operating model, coordinate project and workstream leaders, manage cross-project dependencies and financial outcomes, and provide the executive visibility required to make timely decisions and realize value.

### **Duties and Responsibilities:**

**Program Strategy, Opportunity Shaping, and Commercial Planning**

* Lead program-level shaping of complex lifecycle management programs in partnership with Pre-Sales, Sales, Architects, Technical Leads, Practice leaders, and customer stakeholders.
* Translate a strategic customer objective into an integrated program structure of related projects, workstreams, milestones, outcomes, dependencies, and decision points.
* Develop and validate program assumptions, schedules, delivery approach, staffing strategy and resources forecasting, labor mix, schedule, partner or vendor inputs, and pricing recommendations with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Assess delivery feasibility, challenge solution and schedule assumptions, identify cross-workstream risks, and surface tradeoffs before commitments are made to the customer.
* Support proposals, solution reviews, statements of work, estimates, executive presentations, and internal approvals with practical program-level content.
* Ensure a disciplined transition from opportunity shaping to delivery so that scope, assumptions, commercial commitments, risks, and decisions are understood across the program team.

  

**Program Mobilization and Operating Model**

* Collaborate with the PMO to establish the program charter, integrated master plan, and shared governance model, in alignment with established program frameworks. This includes roles and decision rights, stakeholder alignment on priorities and outcomes, mutual accountability, communication plan, escalation paths, reporting dashboards and cadence, and RAID framework.
* Collaborate with resource management and delivery leaders to forecast resources (internal or third party) as well as align project managers, workstream leads, technical teams, partners, and customer stakeholders around shared outcomes, sequencing, interdependencies, and measures of success.
* Confirm readiness across staffing, customer access, environments, procurement, vendor coordination, technical prerequisites, operational requirements, and required approvals.
* Define program-level standards for status reporting, dependency management, risk escalation, change control, quality, acceptance, and decision documentation.
* Establish program KPIs and dashboards that provide an accurate view of progress, health, financial performance, risks, dependencies, and value realization.
* Coach and support project managers and workstream leads in applying effective delivery practices while maintaining accountability for integrated program outcomes.

  

**Multi-Workstream Technical Delivery and Lifecycle Management**

* Lead execution of large lifecycle management programs across infrastructure, cloud, network, security, platform, data center, or related technology environments.
* Coordinate multiple projects, technical workstreams, delivery teams, partners, and vendors with complex interdependencies and shared milestones.

Systems and reporting

Program operations

Continuous improvement

**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture or a related field, OR equivalent experience.

* Experience supporting construction of service centers, transportation hubs, or infrastructure-heavy facilities.
* Familiarity with permitting and utility coordination processes.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Google workspace, and project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet or Sitetracker).

* Comfortable working in both field and office settings, with occasional travel as needed.

**Preferred:**

jobs.description:
**About Gather AI**  
Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on-time, in full" delivery.  
If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.  
**About the Team**  
Gather AI's Hardware team designs, builds and supports the hardware behind our platform: autonomous inventory drones and camera systems that mount on customers' material handling equipment (MHE). The team includes hardware engineers and technicians who work out of the Pittsburgh HQ. Hardware designs and builds new product implementations, reviews and repairs RMAs, and performs detailed analysis of field failures while Field Ops runs day-to-day customer site support.  
**About the role**  
Our robots are already working in customer warehouses, and every new deployment depends on the right hardware arriving built, configured and ready. In this role, you'll own the hardware side of that: deployment readiness, field hardware escalations and returns, and accurate documentation of deployment configurations and bill of materials (BOMs) across Hardware programs. This is an ownership role and much of the processes behind it are yours to build collaboratively with Hardware leadership. As our Hardware Deployment & Development Coordinator, you'll be the hardware team's hub between development and field operations: making sure each deployment's hardware is ready on time, owning how we handle field hardware issues and returns, and keeping our bills of materials and fleet configurations accurate across all our hardware programs. You'll report to our Director of Hardware and work closely with engineers, technicians, Field Ops, Purchasing and customer implementation teams.  
**What you'll do**

* Own hardware readiness for each customer deployment: build schedules, kit lists, parts status, shipping and site prerequisites.
* Be on site for installs and go-lives as the hardware liaison lead, then hand off cleanly to Field Ops.
* Own tier-2 hardware escalations: triage, route to the right technician or engineer, and close the loop.
* Own our RMA process: intake, disposition, failure analysis coordination and trend reporting back to engineering and suppliers.
* Own BOM accuracy and configuration management across programs, including revision control and serial/config traceability.
* Build and document the processes behind the work, including the readiness checklist, RMA workflow and configuration control.
* Plan development builds and test assets with engineering and the technicians, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Coordinate development builds, test assets and technician schedules, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Give Purchasing a clear demand plan and flag long-lead and single-source risks early.

**What you bring**

* You've owned hardware readiness for deployments, production launches or NPI builds end to end —, covering schedules, kits, parts and handoffs — and kept other teams moving toward the date without direct authority.
* You've owned the record of what hardware is built and implemented: BOMs and revisions, configurations and change control, or RMA processes. Ideally you've build one of these, not just owned it.a BOM or configuration record, an inventory system or an RMA process.
* You can read assembly and part drawings, electrical schematics, and understand critical to quality callouts. drawings and harness pinouts, and you're comfortable getting hands-on to troubleshoot hardware.
* You can take a field escalation from first report to resolution and keep everyone informed along the way.
* You're detail-oriented, agile and adaptable and adapt quickly when plans change.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in warehouse, material handling or forklift environments.
* Robotics or autonomous-vehicle deployment experience.
* Experience working with suppliers or contract manufacturers on ECOs or recurring defects.Experience coordinating with suppliers or contract manufacturers.
* Experience with Document Control, Good Documentation Practices, and Good Manufacturing Practices.

**Location** Pittsburgh, PA (on site) or remote in the US. About one week a month on site in Pittsburgh; when a customer deployment is active, travel to that site takes priority. Eastern time zone is a plus.  
**How we hire** A recruiter conversation, a conversation with the hiring manager, a practical deployment-planning exercise, and a final round with the team. We'll tell you before each step whether AI tools are welcome.

jobs.description:
**Sr Information Security Manager**

**ABOUT MPG**

Market Performance Group (MPG) is a leading end-to-end, strategy & services omnichannel commerce agency focused on creating the best PATH FORWARD — from market strategy to in-market reality — for today’s fastest-growing consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers. Over the years, we’ve built a strong reputation as a trusted partner and valuable resource to a broad range of companies, from Fortune 500 to Private Equity, in categories that include health & wellness, food & beverage, home and hardlines. We revel in the opportunity to guide our clients on their path forward, building and activating strategies that ensure success. Everything we do is driven by our unrelenting commitment to leverage our deep operational experience, unparalleled omnichannel expertise, and industry relationships to drive performance in today’s dynamic omnichannel marketplace.

At MPG, we value our people and their contributions; they are critical to building the MPG Brand. Our leadership team has significant experience driving topline revenue and bottom-line profit, having held senior operating roles at leading CPG manufacturers and retailers. Our highly regarded, seasoned team of 400+ strategy and commercialization professionals brings strong operational experience and a collaborative approach. All team members are singularly focused on providing clients with pragmatic, real-world market approaches, built on the strong consumer, category and marketplace insights needed to create sustainable, profitable brand growth.

  

**Position Overview**

We are looking for an Information Security Manager to own MPG's information security and privacy program end to end: policy, training, incident response, risk, ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance, and the day-to-day security posture of the systems that hold company and client data. This role reports to the VP, Information Technology, and serves as the primary point of contact for senior management, clients, and auditors on security and privacy matters.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can set the policy and run the program — assessing risk, responding to incidents, and building the kind of security and privacy awareness that has to exist across the company, not just inside IT.

This is a security-focused role, not a broader IT management role: infrastructure, applications, and day-to-day IT operations stay with the VP, Information Technology and the rest of the IT organization. You own the security and privacy program; you partner with IT to get it implemented.

  

**What You'll Do**

* Manage the security solutions that protect MPG's applications, infrastructure, and networks, and ensure corporate networks, computers, and storage devices are monitored closely enough to catch attacks and respond to alerts quickly.
* **Incident Response & Risk**

* Own the security and privacy dimensions of business continuity and disaster recovery planning — what has to be protected, restored, and communicated in a disruption — coordinating with IT infrastructure teams on execution.

**Training & Awareness**

* Manage security and privacy awareness training programs and email phishing campaigns across the company.

**Compliance & Audit**

* Own MPG's ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance programs end to end: control ownership, evidence collection, audit prep, and remediation of findings.

* Serve as the primary point of contact for external auditors and certification bodies, and keep certifications current as MPG's environment and client requirements evolve.

* Ensure the information security and privacy function is held to, and maintains, the highest level of confidentiality.

  

**Qualifications**

* Excellent understanding of information security concepts, protocols, industry best practices, and strategies.
* Experience with common information security management frameworks, such as ISO 2700x, NIST 800-53, and COBIT.
* Experience running ISO 27001 and/or SOC 2 compliance programs, including owning controls and leading audits through to certification.
* Experience developing and maintaining security policies, procedures, standards, and guidelines.

* Proficiency in performing risk, business impact, control, and vulnerability assessments, and in defining treatment strategies.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Redica Systems** is the Intelligence Cloud for life sciences, transforming regulatory complexity into connected, proactive intelligence. Redica's platform helps the world's leading Pharmaceutical and MedTech companies stay inspection-ready, manage supplier risk, and keep pace with evolving global regulations. Built on the Redica Catalyst Platform and powered by Redica ID, Redica unifies the industry's most complete regulatory and inspection datasets, sourced from hundreds of global health authorities, into trusted intelligence for quality and regulatory teams. The Redica Intelligence Cloud brings data together to anticipate risk, accelerate compliance, and enable smarter, faster decisions across the enterprise.

More information is available at redica.com.

 **Job Description**

Redica Systems is looking for an Associate Data Analyst to develop customer-facing reports and dashboards using our regulatory intelligence data.

You'll translate customer requests into clear reporting requirements, work with data covering inspections, observations, warning letters, and enforcement actions, and present findings through dashboards, executive reports, and compelling data storytelling.

We're looking for someone who's analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable using AI to improve how they work. Just as important is a practical, down-to-earth approach and the ability to communicate clearly with customers and colleagues.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Translate customer reporting requests into precise, scoped queries using Redica tools, including Sigma, Claude, and Redica MCP, to identify and extract the right underlying data.
* Build, customize, and publish customer-facing reports, including workbooks, data elements, and visualizations tailored to each customer’s needs.
* Own the full report lifecycle, from intake and data identification through build, QA, proofing, and delivery.
* Interpret and validate data outputs for accuracy before any customer-facing delivery. This is not a “pull and send” role; judgment about data quality and relevance is required.
* Navigate regulatory intelligence data, including FDA enforcement actions, Form 483 observations, warning letters, and inspection records, to answer customer-specific questions through structured reporting.
* Manage multiple concurrent customer deliverables with accuracy and on-time delivery.

**About You**

* **Business Insight:** You understand customer reporting needs and how accurate regulatory intelligence data helps customers answer business-critical questions. You can connect data outputs to the customer’s underlying need, not just the literal request.
* **Manages Complexity:** You break down ambiguous reporting requests into clear steps, including data identification, query logic, report building, QA, and delivery. You can work through complex regulatory datasets without losing accuracy or structure.
* **Decision Quality:** You use data, context, and sound judgment to validate outputs, identify anomalies, and confirm that the final result answers the question being asked. You know when to escalate unclear, incomplete, or questionable results.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** You work effectively with internal teams to clarify requests, resolve data questions, and deliver accurate customer-ready work. You communicate clearly and help keep deliverables moving without unnecessary back-and-forth.
* **Tech Savvy:** You are comfortable working with BI tools, structured data, SQL, AI-assisted tools, and analytics workflows. You learn new systems quickly and use technology to improve accuracy, speed, and quality of work.
* **Engaged:** You share our values and possess the essential competencies needed to thrive at Redica, as outlined here: https://redica.com/company

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, business analytics, information systems, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, data operations, or a related role.
* Hands-on experience building reports, workbooks, data elements, or visualizations in a cloud BI or analytics tool, such as Sigma, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; Sigma experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write, review, and troubleshoot queries against structured data.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools or natural language data interfaces to support data exploration, query development, or analysis.
* Experience producing accurate, polished work product for internal stakeholders or external customers.

  
**Additional Information**

Top Pharmaceutical Companies, Food Manufacturers, MedTech Companies, and Service Firms from around the globe rely on Redica Systems to mine and process government inspection, enforcement, and registration data. This enables them to quantify risk signals from their suppliers, identify market opportunities, benchmark against peers, and prepare for the latest inspection trends.

Our data and analytics have been cited by major media outlets, including MSNBC, *The Wall Street Journal*, and *The Boston Globe*.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces - we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company's long-term success.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst who combines a strong foundation in Windows-based IT administration with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating modern information security tools, alongside a governance-focused mindset. This role is critical to the success of our security operations and will play a key part in evaluating, testing, and deploying emerging technologies and new procedures, ensuring JRM remains proactive in an ever-evolving cybersecurity landscape. The ideal candidate is not only technically proficient but also highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain detailed documentation, and uphold structured workflows. The Analyst also shares responsibility for incident response.

Reporting directly to the Manager of Information Security, this position offers an exciting opportunity for a security-minded technologist to thrive within a forward-thinking program that values agility, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

Governance & Risk Management:

* Assist in developing, documenting, and enforcing cybersecurity policies, standards, and control procedures.
* Support alignment with frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Maintain the security risk register and perform technical risk assessments and drive remediation to closure.

Windows IT Administration & Hardening:

* Leverage expertise in Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, and PowerShell to engineer, automate, and maintain secure system baselines.
* Work with the IT and infrastructure teams to ensure secure configurations and compliance enforcement across the environment.
* Deploy, configure, and tune endpoint management and compliance controls using modern UEM, MDM, and EDR tools.

Identity Security & Access Management:

* Implement identity governance practices, privileged access controls, phishing resistant MFA, and conditional access policy design across Microsoft Entra ID and other third-party IdPs.
* Automate and improve lifecycle management processes, including secure onboarding and offboarding.

Phishing Defense & Awareness:

* Operate a phishing simulation and security awareness platform, run phishing simulations, and report on campaign effectiveness.
* Triage user-reported phishing attempts and maintain IT communication templates and user education content.

Security Engineering & Tooling:

* Design, deploy, and maintain core security platforms, including EDR, SIEM, email security, and vulnerability management.
* Maintain configuration baselines and documentation for deployed security tools.
* Integrate security tools with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and the broader IT environment to improve visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Run vulnerability scanning, prioritize findings by risk, and coordinate remediation with IT and infrastructure teams.

Detection, Incident Response & Automation:

* Monitor SIEM alerts and dashboards, and tune detections to reduce noise.
* Act as a technical responder in security incidents: triage, investigate, contain, and document root cause and lessons learned.
* Support incident response playbooks and tabletop exercises.
* Automate repetitive security tasks and response workflows using PowerShell, Python, and SOAR or automation platforms.

Innovation & Emerging Technology Evaluation:

* Participate in research, testing, and proof-of-concept (PoC) efforts for new cybersecurity tools, technologies, and frameworks.
* Deploy new technologies and procedures that improve detection, prevention, and governance.
* Provide technical input and analysis for tool evaluations, pilots, and strategic initiatives.

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 3+ years of experience in IT administration, systems engineering, or information security, with a strong focus on Windows environments.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), third-party IDP providers, Intune, and modern endpoint security tools.
* Scripting and automation skills in PowerShell.
* Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and governance models (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS).
* Analytical, collaborative, and adaptable mindset with strong documentation skills.

Preferred:

* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and tuning security tools such as EDR, email security, and vulnerability management platforms, or evaluating emerging and cloud security solutions.
* Exposure to SIEM detection engineering and SOAR or automation platforms.
* Experience in risk assessments, audit preparation, or compliance reporting.
* Familiarity with Python, SQL, or Bash/Shell for automation and security analysis.

**Salary Information**  
To the extent this position is performed in New York City, the annual salary range for this role is $90,000 - $110,000.

* Security Tooling: Stay ahead of emerging threats and security trends, recommend and vet new tools as appropriate

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **Program Overview**

The program is an IDIQ contract for an AWS-based cloud hosting system. Currently, Peraton is supporting the Cloud Security, IoT, and AIML use cases for the environment in a hybrid work environment with Federal employees. Peraton also support the following applications as part of the environment: Dremio, Tableau, Globus, Posit/RStudio, Atlassian, ThingLogix, Alteryx and CloudCheckr.

##### **About The Role**

  

Peraton is seeking a **Junior Business Analyst** **(Data & Integration)** with a strong data analysis background to support NOAA Fisheries data mapping, interoperability requirements, and compliance documentation on a federal data integration program. This role focuses on the technical business analysis activities that bridge data engineering and regulatory compliance.

  

The Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

  

**Work Location:** Remote

  

**Day to Day Responsibilities:**

* Conduct detailed source-to-target data mapping analysis for NOAA Fisheries species datasets, documenting field-level transformation rules, data type conversions, and null-handling logic.
* Analyze NOAA Fisheries data quality issues identified during prototype ingestion and document remediation requirements.
* Support the Metadata and Authoritative Source Registry by researching and documenting NOAA Fisheries data source attributes, refresh cadences, and data stewardship contacts.
* Assist in the development and documentation of interoperability testing requirements including API connectivity, data exchange protocols, and metadata alignment test cases.
* Support compliance validation checklist development by documenting validation criteria for species list generation, decision logic, and template content completeness.
* Analyze live consultation feedback from production and document actionable requirements for system updates.
* Support the Prototype Ingest Results Report by documenting NOAA Fisheries data quality issues identified during prototype ingestion, including defect descriptions, root cause analysis, and remediation requirements.
* Assist in the development of training metrics dashboard requirements and reporting specifications.
* Support the compilation of final operational documentation by documenting NOAA Fisheries data refresh procedures.

##### **Qualifications**

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 0 years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree with 0 years of professional experience, or an Associate’s degree with 2 years of professional experience, or a high school diploma/equivalent with 4 years of professional experience.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.
* Experience supporting business analysis experience with a focus on data integration or data migration programs.
* Experience with source-to-target data mapping and data quality analysis.
* Familiarity with API integration concepts and interoperability testing requirements.
* Strong analytical and technical documentation skills.
* Experience supporting federal IT programs.
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with NOAA Fisheries or other federal environmental data systems.
* Familiarity with ETL concepts, data pipelines, or cloud data platforms.
* Experience supporting compliance validation activities on federal programs.
* Experience contributing to program status reports or monthly progress reports.
* ECBA or CCBA certification.

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. jobs.description:
**About Vantage**
=================

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Reliability Engineering**

The Reliability Engineering Department is responsible for ensuring the operational health of critical systems and the implementation of Site Operations best practices. This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. The department also collaborates closely with the Design Engineering team to provide feedback for future data center designs.

**Position Overview**

**This role will be based near any of our North America office locations, following our flexible work policy (3 days in-office and 2 days flexible).**

The Sr. Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment - Electrical Design Assurance is responsible for providing operationally focused electrical review and technical assurance for new data center builds, expansions, and major fit-out projects across the North America portfolio. This role represents Site Operations and Site Deployment during design development, page-turn reviews, submittal reviews, RFI responses, commissioning strategy alignment, and movement of design packages toward Issued for Construction drawings.

The position ensures that electrical systems are designed and delivered in a manner that is operable, maintainable, safe, reliable, and aligned with long-term Mission Critical Operations requirements. Working closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and local Site Operations teams, this role brings operator perspective into electrical design decisions before construction execution, procurement, and turnover activities create downstream operational risk.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Serve as the primary Site Deployment representative for electrical design assurance across assigned campuses, projects, and expansions.
* Participate in design page-turn reviews and provide operator-focused comments from concept design through IFC drawing issuance.
* Review electrical design packages, one-line diagrams, specifications, sequences of operation, equipment schedules, load studies, and drawing sets for operability, maintainability, safety, and reliability.
* Review electrical submittals, equipment selections, vendor documentation, and proposed alternates to evaluate operational impact, maintainability requirements, protection strategy, and lifecycle risk.
* Support responses to RFIs related to electrical distribution, equipment access, switching, redundancy, load management, protection coordination, EPMS interfaces, maintenance clearances, and long-term serviceability.
* Evaluate value engineering proposals and design changes to ensure critical operational requirements are not removed, reduced, or compromised without appropriate risk visibility.
* Provide technical input for electrical commissioning strategies, operational acceptance criteria, test scripts, integrated systems testing, energization plans, and turnover readiness expectations.
* Collaborate with Site Deployment TPMs and future MCO teams to ensure electrical design intent is carried forward into construction, commissioning, training, CMMS population, and steady-state operations.
* Capture lessons learned from active operating sites and deployment projects and feed them back into future electrical design standards, templates, and review criteria.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review electrical design milestones including 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC, bulletin, and construction revision packages.
* Assess utility service arrangements, medium-voltage distribution, low-voltage distribution, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators, fuel systems interfaces, transfer schemes, busways, panels, grounding, lightning protection, batteries, and EPMS architecture.
* Validate maintenance access, equipment clearances, working space, switching paths, isolation strategy, arc flash considerations, labeling, redundancy philosophy, and operational workflows within electrical spaces.
* Track design review comments, assigned actions, and open electrical issues through closure with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Site Operations stakeholders.
* Participate in recurring design coordination meetings, page turns, constructability reviews, operability reviews, energization planning, and commissioning planning sessions.
* Review MEP coordination impacts where electrical systems interface with mechanical, controls, fire protection, security, architectural, structural, civil, and utility scopes.
* Provide operator perspective on sequence of operations, switching procedures, alarm strategy, metering, trending capability, EPMS points, electrical safety requirements, and emergency operating scenarios.
* Review proposed equipment substitutions or manufacturer deviations for potential impacts to maintainability, spare parts, training, warranty, resilience, and operational standardization.
* Support development of operational design standards, electrical review checklists, lessons learned repositories, and acceptance criteria used by the Site Deployment organization.
* Partner with local MCO leadership to ensure future operators understand electrical design intent, operating limitations, maintenance requirements, and known risk items prior to turnover.

**Job Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in data center operations, electrical engineering, commissioning, critical facilities maintenance, construction QA/QC, or mission-critical infrastructure

**Working within an integrated client environment, the role will provide leadership and coordination throughout the project lifecycle, from feasibility, option appraisal and business case development through design, procurement, construction, commissioning and operational readiness. jobs.title: Business Analyst Consultant
jobs.description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

Visa Consulting and Analytics (VCA) is the consulting arm of Visa, and drives tangible, impactful and financial results for Visa’s network clients, including both financial services and merchants. Drawing on our expertise in strategy consulting, data analytics, brand management, marketing, operational and macroeconomics, VCA solves the most strategic problems for our clients.

VCA Implementation Services (VIS) is an augmentation of Visa’s consultancy offering, supporting the execution and implementation of recommendations to help scale competitive advantage and operate to succeed in the digital age.

We are looking for a Business Analyst Consultant to work with some of Visa's leading clients. You will be responsible for performing technical assessments and business analysis to position our client’s products at the very top of the market. You will act as one of the key touchpoints between the client and Visa, liaising with both to analyze data trends, identifying opportunities for improvements and support the deployment of the appropriate Visa solutions to boost revenue.

What we expect of you, day to day:

* Champion Data Analytics: Promote innovative use of data and analytics to address client business challenges.
* Trend Identification: Spot and share trends in client projects, strategic goals and pain points to guide our data product development and service offerings.
* Technical Analysis: Work with product and design teams to technically define opportunities for potential improvements.
* Enhance Profitability: Utilize data to develop profitability assessments contributing towards business cases and management of card and payment portfolios.
* Data-driven Optimization: Design and support the execution of financially viable testing approaches to optimize go-to-market strategy.
* Product Development: Assist in defining product enhancements, requirements, and new features.
* Collaborate with Visa Product Teams: Work with our clients to efficiently support the technical implementation of relevant Visa products and services solutions.
* Thought Leadership: Provide expertise in business analysis techniques and development approaches.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

**What we'd like from you -**

Essential:

* Proven experience in business analyst roles.
* Expert in Agile delivery methods and associated software (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
* Background in payment, retail banking, or retail merchant industries.
* Flexible approach to working to match our various clients, but with strong emphasis on collaborative communication and taking ownership for delivery.
* Ability to tailor the presentation of analysis, requirements and recommendations for various audience levels depending on seniority and technical proficiency.
* Strong consultative skills to build relationships across the organisation.
* Results-oriented with strong analytical, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
* Awareness of the key drivers of profitability and how to calculate it.
* Excellent storyteller, conveying interpretation of evidence and analysis against strategic objectives resulting in explicit recommended actions.

Desirable:

* Experience in product feature end-to-end delivery.
* Project management experience delivering across multiple stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to write clean code in SQL and Python, C# or Java with accompanying knowledge of their industry-standard libraries and frameworks.
* Thought leader with the ability to guide, influence, and inspire performance across the technical development landscape.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - EV Charging Platform OCPP & NET Core
jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

We are an end-to-end Renewable Energy provider. We offer products to commercial and enterprise clients in EV Charging solutions, Fleet Electrification, Solar Micro-grids, Energy storage, Hydroponic farming and Rain Water/Grey Water collection systems. We have been experiencing tremendous growth in all these areas and operate under several government rebate programs that ensure a steady and reliable flow of revenues. Our company handles the entire flow of providing these products and services beginning with Sales, Provisioning, Design and Engineering, Contracting and Construction, Servicing and Maintenance. If you are passionate about the EV industry and working with awesome teams in a fast-growing company, we want to speak with you! Join us in making a meaningful impact!

**JOB SUMMARY**

You will own the delivery of our cloud Charging Station Management System (CSMS): a .NET Core platform that keeps thousands of DC fast chargers and Level 2 stations online, billing correctly, and compliant with OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1. The chargers are hardware from multiple manufacturers running firmware we do not control; the platform must talk to all of them reliably, at scale, over long-lived WebSocket connections.  
  
This is a hands-on technical program role, not a project-coordination role. You will read OCPP message logs, sit in on architecture reviews, decide when a firmware vendor's deviation from spec gets a workaround versus a pushback, and translate utility, regulator and customer requirements into engineering milestones the team can commit to. You are the single point of accountability for whether the platform roadmap ships on time and interoperates in the field.

You will work across backend engineering, firmware and hardware partners, QA and certification, field operations, and commercial teams, and act as the primary technical interface to charger manufacturers, charge point operators (CPOs), e-mobility service providers (eMSPs) and enterprise fleet customers.

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**Program strategy and roadmap**

Own the CSMS technical roadmap: define program scope, phase gates, success criteria and release cadence, and keep it aligned with commercial commitments and regulatory deadlines.  

Translate business, customer and regulatory requirements into epics, acceptance criteria and milestones engineering can estimate and commit to.  
Run quarterly planning, weekly program reviews and release go/no-go decisions; publish status, risks and decisions to leadership in a form non-engineers can act on.  
Prioritize across competing demands (new charger onboarding, customer integrations, protocol upgrades, platform reliability) with explicit trade-offs, not a growing backlog.  

**OCPP implementation and interoperability**

Oversee implementation and conformance of OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1 across all supported profiles: Core, Firmware Management, Local Auth List, Reservation, Smart Charging, Remote Trigger, and 2.0.1 functional blocks including Provisioning, Authorization, Transactions, Tariff & Cost, Diagnostics and Security.  

Own the charger onboarding program: define the certification matrix per manufacturer/firmware version, run interoperability test plans, and sign off before a model is approved for field deployment.  
Maintain the known-deviations register: where a vendor's firmware departs from spec, decide between a platform-side workaround, a vendor fix, or declining support, and document the decision.  
Lead the OCPP 1.6J to 2.0.1 migration plan for the installed base, including dual-protocol operation, security profile upgrades (TLS, client certificates), and firmware rollout sequencing.  
Coordinate participation in OCA plugfests and third-party conformance testing; track OCPP 2.1 and ISO 15118-20 readiness.  

**Architecture and engineering partnership**

Partner with .NET Core architects on an event-driven microservices design that handles tens of thousands of concurrent WebSocket sessions, high-frequency MeterValues ingestion, and exactly-once transaction handling.  

Set and enforce non-functional requirements: connection stability, message latency, offline transaction recovery, horizontal scalability, observability and multi-region failover.  
Review technical designs for protocol correctness, backward compatibility and operational risk before implementation starts.  
Ensure the platform exposes clean, versioned APIs for customer portals, mobile apps, fleet management systems, payment processors and OCPI partners.  

**Risk, dependency and quality management**

Identify and mitigate hardware-to-cloud compatibility risks, firmware update bottlenecks, certificate expiry, and cross-team dependencies before they affect field uptime.  

Own the incident review loop for protocol-related outages: root cause, corrective action, and roadmap change if the failure is structural.  
Define release quality bars: automated OCPP conformance tests, load tests against charger simulators, and staged rollouts with rollback criteria.  
Track and report platform KPIs: charger uptime, session success rate, transaction reconciliation accuracy, mean time to onboard a new charger model, and firmware campaign completion rate.  

**Stakeholder, vendor and customer management**

Act as the primary technical interface for charger manufacturers, firmware vendors, utilities, CPOs, eMSPs and enterprise fleet customers.  

Negotiate technical scope, timelines and acceptance criteria with vendors; hold them to delivery and escalate with evidence when they slip.  
Lead customer-facing technical onboarding for large deployments: integration design, cutover plans, pilot acceptance and hypercare.  
Drive hardware certification and compliance workstreams (UL/ETL listing, Energy Star, NEVI/CFI program requirements, utility make-ready and demand-response integrations) in coordination with hardware and compliance teams.  

**Security and compliance**

Own the OCPP 2.0.1 security program: security

jobs.title: Operations Analyst, Acquisitions & Inventory
jobs.description:
About Winston TCG

We're Winston TCG, a trading card company in Arcadia. We started about three years ago and we sell Pokémon cards on TikTok Shop, Whatnot, eBay, Shopify, Walmart, and Best Buy, with livestreams running most of the day. We buy a lot of our cards in Japan, grade them, and sell them on stream. We're also opening our first retail store here in Arcadia.

We're a young, fast-growing company, and we're looking for someone who wants to help build out the buying side of the business with us.

The role

This is a data role first. You'd own the numbers behind our card buying and grading operation — what we pay, what grades, what sells, what we net — and turn that into clean reporting leadership can act on each week. From there you'd keep cash and inventory tight and use what the data shows to guide the buyers on what to pick up and what to leave alone.

It's hands-on. You'll split your time between the spreadsheets and the card room.

Here's what you'd be responsible for:

* **The numbers.** Every stream, buying trip, and grading submission tracked: cost, sale price, fees, net. You'd build and own the weekly report — gross, net, margin, ROI by stream and by source — plus the numbers that drive buying decisions, like cost per graded 10, grading hit rate by source, and which cards and sets are actually moving on which platform. Getting that built is the first thing you'd do.
* **Cash.** Our buyers travel with cash to Japan and to shows. You'd issue it, log it, and reconcile every trip within a couple of days of the team getting back.
* **Inventory and the grading pipeline.** Cards come in, get checked, go out to grading, and come back for stream. You'd know where everything is, what it cost, and what it's worth at every step, and flag cards that aren't likely to grade well before we pay to submit them.
* **Guiding the buyers.** You won't be the one on the floor in Osaka. You'd build the buy lists and the rules the buyers work from — price ceilings, how many copies of a card we need, what's selling and what isn't — and check trip lists against inventory before anyone spends money.
* **The room.** Inventory organized and labeled well enough that when a host asks for a card, someone can find it fast.
* **The team's day to day.** Coordinating schedules and output for the buyers and processors, helping train new people, and giving leadership an honest read on how things are going.
* **Shows and trips.** Supporting card-show runs and Japan trips from the office: buy lists, cash, logistics, and the numbers review afterward.

About you

I don't care much about where you worked before. I care about how you work. The people who do well here have good common sense, keep real numbers, and don't need to be told twice. Here's what I'm looking for:

* You live in spreadsheets. Hand you a messy export and you'll come back with the three numbers that matter, not a 20-tab workbook.
* You're tight with cash. Every dollar is accounted for, every trip is reconciled, and you don't need reminding.
* You handle curve balls. Shipment's late, show was a bust, someone bought off the list — you deal with it that day and then put a rule in place so it doesn't happen again.
* You have good sense. I'll give you the goal and the context. I won't always have a procedure written down, and I need you to make the right call anyway.
* You tell me straight. If something's not working, I want to hear it from you with the numbers, not find out later.
* You like cards or you're curious about them. You don't need to be a Pokémon expert — the team has that — but you'll need to learn how to check condition in your first couple of months.

Requirements

**Must have**

jobs.title: Program Manager, Accounting Operations & Strategy
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic is seeking a Program Manager to join our Accounting organization and help it run as one global team. Accounting is scaling at an unprecedented pace across multiple hubs, and the goals, rhythms, programs, and people that make up the team need to stay connected as we grow. In this role, you will own that connective tissue: the annual goal-setting cycle, the leadership team’s operating cadence, org-wide events and internal communications, and the programs that make a distributed team feel like one.

You will partner with Accounting leadership, the People team, Finance Systems, and hub leads. This is a hands-on role with a lot of range: part chief of staff, part program manager, part culture builder.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

### **Goals and operating rhythm**

* Run the annual goal setting process and the reporting that tracks progress against those goals.
* Look at how the org actually operates (meetings, handoffs, planning cycles, decision making) and fix what isn't working.
* Maintain one org-wide planning calendar that shows close, audit, and team milestones alongside company-wide and team events, so leaders can see the pressure points and plan around them.
* Build and maintain a simple set of org health metrics (attrition, engagement scores, hiring pipeline, training completion, survey trends) and report on them regularly.

### **Leadership and org-wide events**

* Run our extended leadership team (XLT) program, including agendas, meetings, follow-ups, and action items.
* Own planning and agenda for the annual offsite and run the quarterly team all-hands.
* Write the internal updates: a regular team newsletter, plus talking points when leadership needs to explain a change to the whole org.

### **People and culture**

* Coordinate projects across the org that support employee experience programs.
* Partner with the People team to roll out training and development programs for Accounting.
* Review team survey results, identify the themes, and build action plans to address the feedback. Follow through and report back to the team.
* Run hub programs, including visit and rotation programs, local hub events, and meeting norms that work across time zones, so we feel like one global team.
* Run recognition and team rituals: wins, milestones, anniversaries, and peer recognition, especially across hubs.

### **Team operations**

* Support contractor management, including onboarding, tracking, and coordination with the right partners.
* Keep the team's knowledge base current: wiki, org charts, role descriptions, and key process docs.
* Keep the team calendar accurate so everyone knows what's coming.

**Preferred qualifications**
----------------------------

* 7+ years in program management, operations, chief of staff, or strategy roles. Experience inside a finance or accounting org is a plus, but not required.
* A track record of running recurring programs end to end and getting people to follow through without formal authority.
* Good judgment about what matters and what doesn't. You can handle a lot of moving pieces without dropping them.
* Clear, direct writing. You can brief a senior leader in a few sentences.
* Comfort with confidential information and sensitive people topics.
* Experience supporting distributed or global teams.
* You're organized, but you also know when a process is getting in the way and should be simplified.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:

$230,000 - $300,000 USD

**Logistics**
-------------

**Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

**Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

**Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

**Location-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

**Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.  
  
**Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Design Tools & Enablement - Product, Design & Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
PD&M Operations provides the foundation that enables our organization (Product, Design & Marketing) to run smoothly at scale. We’re makers and doers, with a focus on practices, tools, and culture. We ensure that our teams have what they need to work effectively and deliver amazing experiences to our customers.  
  
We’re looking for a Program Manager to lead the implementation, enablement, governance, and ongoing management of enterprise tools that support our creative and product organizations.  
  
**Description**  
  
The Program Manager, Design Tools & Enablement partners closely with business teams, Technology, and external vendors to understand how teams work, translate business needs into scalable solutions, and ensure tools are effectively adopted and continuously improved.  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong program management and operational skills with deep expertise in Figma and experience supporting complex, highly collaborative organizations. While this role will initially focus on Figma, the broader role is built around a common set of skills and practices that can be applied across the portfolio of tools managed by PD&M Operations.  
  
","responsibilities":"Partner with designers, producers, and business leaders to understand workflows, pain points, and business requirements, translating them into scalable tool strategies and solutions.  
  
Lead cross-functional programs from discovery and requirements through implementation, adoption, and ongoing optimization, establishing goals, milestones, dependencies, risks, and measures of success.  
  
Lead the configuration, deployment, and ongoing management of Figma, including workspace architecture, libraries, permissions, access, and governance.  
  
Develop and execute adoption, change-management, communication, and training strategies that enable teams to effectively use new tools, features, and workflows.  
  
Establish and maintain governance, standards, documentation, and operating processes, while monitoring usage and identifying opportunities to improve the platform and user experience.  
  
Partner with Technology and other internal teams to manage integrations, security, technical dependencies, and scalable platform practices.  
  
Monitor the Figma product roadmap and partner with Figma and internal Technology teams to evaluate new capabilities, integrations, and opportunities for the organization.  
  
Serve as a trusted source of knowledge for Figma capabilities, best practices, workflows, and troubleshooting.  
  
Communicate program status, key decisions, risks, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership, and proactively identify and address challenges.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
  
Background in UX/UI, product design, design operations, frontend development, or a related field.  
  
Experience administering enterprise design, collaboration, or productivity platforms.  
  
Experience with project and workflow management platforms such as Wrike or Airtable.  
  
Experience working with SaaS vendors and enterprise Technology organizations.  
  
Experience developing training, enablement, or organizational change-management programs.  
  
Experience working in a large, global, or highly distributed organization.

jobs.title: Program Manager, National Security Policy Operations
jobs.description:
Global Affairs - San Francisco and Washington, DC

  

**About the Team**
------------------

OpenAI's mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We believe that achieving our goal requires effective engagement with public policy stakeholders and the broader community impacted by AI. The Global Affairs team builds trusted relationships that help external stakeholders understand advanced AI and ensure that their perspectives inform our work. Within Global Affairs, the National Security Policy team works across OpenAI to understand how increasingly capable AI systems affect security, governance, and democratic resilience, and to advance policies that support the responsible development and use of AI.

**About the Role**
------------------

OpenAI is seeking a highly organized and skilled Program Manager, National Security Policy Operations to join the Global Affairs team, reporting directly to Sasha Baker, who leads the National Security Policy team. This is a hands-on program management role focused on running the planning, coordination, and execution systems that enable the team to operate effectively.

This person will translate team priorities into executable plansed decisions; and ensuring priorities move reliably from scoping through completion. The ideal candidate takes deep pride in program management as a craft and is energized by enabling policy and technical experts to do their best work. The role works closely with policy experts but is not primarily responsible for setting policy positions or serving as the team's external policy lead.

This role may be based in San Francisco or Washington, DC. It will require travel as necessary,

and we offer relocation assistance to new employees.

**Key responsibilities include:**
---------------------------------

* Run portfolio planning and team operations, including intake, workplans, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and progress reporting. Surface capacity constraints, recommend sequencing and tradeoffs, and escalate decisions to the team lead, who sets priorities and makes resource decisions.
* Build and maintain lightweight, repeatable operating systems for planning, meeting cadences, knowledge management, decision logs, and centralized tracking of developments, commitments, and follow-up.
* Own the team's program metrics and central tracking of commitments, owners, deadlines, dependencies, decisions, and follow-up. Keep records current and reliable, and produce concise updates and practical dashboards that make progress, risks, and decisions clear to policy leaders.
* Coordinate policy deliverables and external engagements from planning through follow-up. Assemble briefing packages; draft talking points, presentations, readouts, and updates; organize visits and convenings, including logistics; manage review cycles; and track action items through completion, with substantive input and approval from policy leads.
* Own operational management of the team's contractors and consultantsance against agreed deliverables, and flag issues requiring the team lead's decision.
* Coordinate across Global Affairs, Research, Safety, Security, Product Policy, Legal, Communications, and OpenAI for Government to manage dependencies, surface decisions, and advance shared priorities.
* Continuously improve the team's operating model through feedback loops, retrospectives, and thoughtful use of AI, automation, and lightweight tooling.

**You should thrive in this role if you:**
------------------------------------------

* Enjoy learning enough technical and policy context to coordinate work effectively and synthesize expert inputs into clear briefing materials and updates for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Thrive in fast-paced, flexible environments where priorities evolve and good judgment matters.
* Collaborate effectively across policy, technical, legal, operational, and business teams.
* Can lead complex workstreams and keep stakeholders aligned through influence rather than formal authority.
* View program management as a craft in its own right and take satisfaction in building durable systems, creating clarity, and helping teams deliver reliably.
* Are passionate about the promise of AI and thoughtful about its potential national security and societal risks.
* Are energized by enabling subject-matter experts and leaders to do their best work, and bring high standards, low ego, curiosity, and a strong service orientation.

**We're looking for a blend of:**
---------------------------------

* 5+ years of relevant experience in program management, project management, policy operations, strategic operations, chief of staff, government program delivery, or related roles.
* Experience coordinating complex work across multiple stakeholders and building practical systems that help teams deliver. Experience supporting policy, government, national security, or technical teams is a plus.
* A track record of independently driving complex cross-functional programs from scoping through delivery, managing stakeholders, dependencies, and risks while building durable systems and delivering measurable outcomes.
* Strong analytical, writing, and communication skills, with the ability to synthesize quantitative and qualitative inputs into crisp decision materials, action plans, and executive-ready updates.
* The ability to understand strategic context while remaining hands-on in detailed executional authority, and exercise sound judgment and discretion in fast-moving, sensitive environments.
* Genuine care for the impact of AI on national securityal project or program management certification is welcome but not required.

**About OpenAI**

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products.
