jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment - Electrical Design Assurance, NA
jobs.description:
**About Vantage**
=================

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Reliability Engineering**

The Reliability Engineering Department is responsible for ensuring the operational health of critical systems and the implementation of Site Operations best practices. This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. The department also collaborates closely with the Design Engineering team to provide feedback for future data center designs.

**Position Overview**

**This role will be based near any of our North America office locations, following our flexible work policy (3 days in-office and 2 days flexible).**

The Sr. Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment - Electrical Design Assurance is responsible for providing operationally focused electrical review and technical assurance for new data center builds, expansions, and major fit-out projects across the North America portfolio. This role represents Site Operations and Site Deployment during design development, page-turn reviews, submittal reviews, RFI responses, commissioning strategy alignment, and movement of design packages toward Issued for Construction drawings.

The position ensures that electrical systems are designed and delivered in a manner that is operable, maintainable, safe, reliable, and aligned with long-term Mission Critical Operations requirements. Working closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and local Site Operations teams, this role brings operator perspective into electrical design decisions before construction execution, procurement, and turnover activities create downstream operational risk.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Serve as the primary Site Deployment representative for electrical design assurance across assigned campuses, projects, and expansions.
* Participate in design page-turn reviews and provide operator-focused comments from concept design through IFC drawing issuance.
* Review electrical design packages, one-line diagrams, specifications, sequences of operation, equipment schedules, load studies, and drawing sets for operability, maintainability, safety, and reliability.
* Review electrical submittals, equipment selections, vendor documentation, and proposed alternates to evaluate operational impact, maintainability requirements, protection strategy, and lifecycle risk.
* Support responses to RFIs related to electrical distribution, equipment access, switching, redundancy, load management, protection coordination, EPMS interfaces, maintenance clearances, and long-term serviceability.
* Evaluate value engineering proposals and design changes to ensure critical operational requirements are not removed, reduced, or compromised without appropriate risk visibility.
* Provide technical input for electrical commissioning strategies, operational acceptance criteria, test scripts, integrated systems testing, energization plans, and turnover readiness expectations.
* Collaborate with Site Deployment TPMs and future MCO teams to ensure electrical design intent is carried forward into construction, commissioning, training, CMMS population, and steady-state operations.
* Capture lessons learned from active operating sites and deployment projects and feed them back into future electrical design standards, templates, and review criteria.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review electrical design milestones including 30%, 60%, 90%, IFC, bulletin, and construction revision packages.
* Assess utility service arrangements, medium-voltage distribution, low-voltage distribution, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators, fuel systems interfaces, transfer schemes, busways, panels, grounding, lightning protection, batteries, and EPMS architecture.
* Validate maintenance access, equipment clearances, working space, switching paths, isolation strategy, arc flash considerations, labeling, redundancy philosophy, and operational workflows within electrical spaces.
* Track design review comments, assigned actions, and open electrical issues through closure with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, and Site Operations stakeholders.
* Participate in recurring design coordination meetings, page turns, constructability reviews, operability reviews, energization planning, and commissioning planning sessions.
* Review MEP coordination impacts where electrical systems interface with mechanical, controls, fire protection, security, architectural, structural, civil, and utility scopes.
* Provide operator perspective on sequence of operations, switching procedures, alarm strategy, metering, trending capability, EPMS points, electrical safety requirements, and emergency operating scenarios.
* Review proposed equipment substitutions or manufacturer deviations for potential impacts to maintainability, spare parts, training, warranty, resilience, and operational standardization.
* Support development of operational design standards, electrical review checklists, lessons learned repositories, and acceptance criteria used by the Site Deployment organization.
* Partner with local MCO leadership to ensure future operators understand electrical design intent, operating limitations, maintenance requirements, and known risk items prior to turnover.

**Job Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in data center operations, electrical engineering, commissioning, critical facilities maintenance, construction QA/QC, or mission-critical infrastructure

jobs.description:
Trust & Safety - San Francisco

**About the Team**

At OpenAIs of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role will take on new, ambiguous, or underdeveloped operational risks and help mature them into scalable capabilities. We work across USRO and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Legal, Safety, Support, and external vendors or partnership stakeholders.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Operations Analyst to take on complex, ambiguous safety and risk problems and turn them into practical operational solutions that can scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a versatile operator who is comfortable moving between queues, investigation, analysis, workflow design, hands-on execution, and cross-functional leadership. Depending on team needs, the role may focus on emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployment partnerships, or other new operational areas.

You will be expected to move quickly, work hands-on, and create structure without waiting for perfect requirements or a large support team. The work starts with the problem, not a prescribed process. You may investigate unstructured user signals, stand up a lightweight workflow, build an AI-assisted tool, improve an existing operation, or help a new launch become operationally ready. The goal is to produce durable systems that other people can run, not simply complete a series of individual tasks.

The portfolio will change with company priorities and may span established harm areas, emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployments and partnerships, device safety, or new product launches. Some hires may focus primarily on cloud deployment operations, including launch readiness, partner coordination, safety workflows, and operational monitoring. You will typically own a small number of high-impact problems at a time and will be expected to judge what needs to be built, what can stay lightweight, and when the work is ready to scale, transfer, or stop.

Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office.

***Please note:*** *This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.*

**In This Role, You Will**

* Take ownership of ambiguous, high-priority safety and risk problems: define the problem, gather the right evidence, choose a practical path, drive execution, and close the loop.
* Analyze structured and unstructured data, both quantitative and qualitative. This may include user reports, case narratives, conversations, escalations, and operational metrics to identify patterns, risks, and the highest-leverage interventions.
* Build and test lightweight workflows, tools, automations, and decision aids that improve speed, quality, and consistency, then iterate based on real-world use.
* Turn one-off insights and manual work into scalable operating mechanisms without adding unnecessary process or complexity.
* Lead sensitive investigations, incident response, or launch-readiness work, including safety workflows, human review, escalation paths, partner coordination, and operational monitoring for product launches or cloud deployments.
* Work directly with cross-functional and external partners to clarify ownership, resolve operational gaps, and turn incomplete signals into clear recommendations and decisions.
* Measure whether the work is improving outcomes—such as quality, speed, coverage, operator effort, or risk reduction—and adjust quickly when it is not.
* Help junior operators build judgment and independence through coaching, calibration, and reusable tools.

**You Might Thrive in This Role If You**

* Have 8+ years of experience in trust and safety operations, investigations, incident response, product operations, technical program management, or another high-judgment, data-heavy operational field.
* Have a track record as a scrappy generalist who can enter an unfamiliar problem, learn quickly, and deliver with limited structure or support.
* Are highly data savvyation and combine it with quantitative evidence.
* Are technically fluent and hands-on with AI tools, dashboards, and data tooling, and can build or prototype practical solutions without waiting for a dedicated technical team.
* Operate independently, make clear tradeoffs, and maintain momentum as priorities and requirements change.
* Think in systems: you look beyond the immediate task and build approaches that can be repeated, measured, and operated by others.
* Exercise strong judgment in sensitive situations involving user impact, policy, legal risk, technical constraints, and business priorities.
* Communicate clearly and directlyal authority.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in trust and safety, fraud, product safety, integrity, or another adversarial or high-severity risk domain.
* Experience moving a new or immature workflow from early investigation into stable, scaled operations.
* Experience supporting cloud platforms or deployment partnerships, enterprise products, product launches, connected devices, or other technically complex programs. Direct cloud experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Familiarity with SQL, lightweight scripting, no-code tools, workflow automation, or AI-assisted development.
* Experience with vendor operations, quality programs, calibrations, or distributed operational teams.

**About OpenAI**

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

**ABOUT MPG**

Market Performance Group (MPG) is a leading end-to-end, strategy & services omnichannel commerce agency focused on creating the best PATH FORWARD — from market strategy to in-market reality — for today’s fastest-growing consumer packaged goods (CPG) manufacturers. new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager - EV Charging Platform OCPP & NET Core
new_jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE:**

We are an end-to-end Renewable Energy provider. We offer products to commercial and enterprise clients in EV Charging solutions, Fleet Electrification, Solar Micro-grids, Energy storage, Hydroponic farming and Rain Water/Grey Water collection systems. We have been experiencing tremendous growth in all these areas and operate under several government rebate programs that ensure a steady and reliable flow of revenues. Our company handles the entire flow of providing these products and services beginning with Sales, Provisioning, Design and Engineering, Contracting and Construction, Servicing and Maintenance. If you are passionate about the EV industry and working with awesome teams in a fast-growing company, we want to speak with you! Join us in making a meaningful impact!

**JOB SUMMARY**

You will own the delivery of our cloud Charging Station Management System (CSMS): a .NET Core platform that keeps thousands of DC fast chargers and Level 2 stations online, billing correctly, and compliant with OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1. The chargers are hardware from multiple manufacturers running firmware we do not control; the platform must talk to all of them reliably, at scale, over long-lived WebSocket connections.  
  
This is a hands-on technical program role, not a project-coordination role. You will read OCPP message logs, sit in on architecture reviews, decide when a firmware vendor's deviation from spec gets a workaround versus a pushback, and translate utility, regulator and customer requirements into engineering milestones the team can commit to. You are the single point of accountability for whether the platform roadmap ships on time and interoperates in the field.

You will work across backend engineering, firmware and hardware partners, QA and certification, field operations, and commercial teams, and act as the primary technical interface to charger manufacturers, charge point operators (CPOs), e-mobility service providers (eMSPs) and enterprise fleet customers.

  

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

**Program strategy and roadmap**

Own the CSMS technical roadmap: define program scope, phase gates, success criteria and release cadence, and keep it aligned with commercial commitments and regulatory deadlines.  

Translate business, customer and regulatory requirements into epics, acceptance criteria and milestones engineering can estimate and commit to.  
Run quarterly planning, weekly program reviews and release go/no-go decisions; publish status, risks and decisions to leadership in a form non-engineers can act on.  
Prioritize across competing demands (new charger onboarding, customer integrations, protocol upgrades, platform reliability) with explicit trade-offs, not a growing backlog.  

**OCPP implementation and interoperability**

Oversee implementation and conformance of OCPP 1.6J and 2.0.1 across all supported profiles: Core, Firmware Management, Local Auth List, Reservation, Smart Charging, Remote Trigger, and 2.0.1 functional blocks including Provisioning, Authorization, Transactions, Tariff & Cost, Diagnostics and Security.  

Own the charger onboarding program: define the certification matrix per manufacturer/firmware version, run interoperability test plans, and sign off before a model is approved for field deployment.  
Maintain the known-deviations register: where a vendor's firmware departs from spec, decide between a platform-side workaround, a vendor fix, or declining support, and document the decision.  
Lead the OCPP 1.6J to 2.0.1 migration plan for the installed base, including dual-protocol operation, security profile upgrades (TLS, client certificates), and firmware rollout sequencing.  
Coordinate participation in OCA plugfests and third-party conformance testing; track OCPP 2.1 and ISO 15118-20 readiness.  

**Architecture and engineering partnership**

Partner with .NET Core architects on an event-driven microservices design that handles tens of thousands of concurrent WebSocket sessions, high-frequency MeterValues ingestion, and exactly-once transaction handling.  

Set and enforce non-functional requirements: connection stability, message latency, offline transaction recovery, horizontal scalability, observability and multi-region failover.  
Review technical designs for protocol correctness, backward compatibility and operational risk before implementation starts.  
Ensure the platform exposes clean, versioned APIs for customer portals, mobile apps, fleet management systems, payment processors and OCPI partners.  

**Risk, dependency and quality management**

Identify and mitigate hardware-to-cloud compatibility risks, firmware update bottlenecks, certificate expiry, and cross-team dependencies before they affect field uptime.  

Own the incident review loop for protocol-related outages: root cause, corrective action, and roadmap change if the failure is structural.  
Define release quality bars: automated OCPP conformance tests, load tests against charger simulators, and staged rollouts with rollback criteria.  
Track and report platform KPIs: charger uptime, session success rate, transaction reconciliation accuracy, mean time to onboard a new charger model, and firmware campaign completion rate.  

**Stakeholder, vendor and customer management**

Act as the primary technical interface for charger manufacturers, firmware vendors, utilities, CPOs, eMSPs and enterprise fleet customers.  

Negotiate technical scope, timelines and acceptance criteria with vendors; hold them to delivery and escalate with evidence when they slip.  
Lead customer-facing technical onboarding for large deployments: integration design, cutover plans, pilot acceptance and hypercare.  
Drive hardware certification and compliance workstreams (UL/ETL listing, Energy Star, NEVI/CFI program requirements, utility make-ready and demand-response integrations) in coordination with hardware and compliance teams.  

**Security and compliance**

Own the OCPP 2.0.1 security program: security

**Description**

  
**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

We are looking for a TPO Business Analyst to join our TPO Business Strategy team to serve as the analytical engine connecting product development, operations, and enterprise partner feedback. This role will own product and process gap analysis — identifying where our TPO platform falls short against enterprise partner needs, investor requirements, and operational best practices — and translate those findings into actionable requirements for engineering and process improvements for operations. The ideal candidate will have experience in solar finance, business analysis, or operations and will work across Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets, and Risk teams.

This position will be based out of San Francisco, CA or Santa Clara, CA with an in-office schedule set at the direct manager’s discretion in accordance with the company policies and procedures.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Conduct end-to-end product and process gap analyses by mapping the TPO customer journey (sale creation through asset onboarding), identifying structural gaps, and categorizing them by severity and business impact — similar in scope to internal initiatives like Project Clarity.

* Translate voice-of-customer feedback from enterprise installer partners and investor/capital markets stakeholders into structured product requirements and operational process change proposals for Engineering and Operations teams.

* Own change order and milestone enforcement analysis — evaluate current process controls (e.g., CO enforcement at NTP, M2 as-built verification, Year 1 kWh reconciliation), identify attack vectors and failure modes, and design minimum viable fixes that require no or minimal engineering development.

* Build detailed gap analysis deliverables (Word docs, Excel models, process flow diagrams) that clearly articulate current state vs. target state, root cause, and prioritized remediation paths with implementation timelines.

* Partner with the Operations team to redesign operational process flows when gaps are identified — drafting new SOPs, updating milestone checklists, and coordinating rollout across QSS and internal ops stakeholders.

* Support product development prioritization by maintaining a living backlog of product gaps mapped to partner impact, investor risk, and revenue exposure — enabling data-driven sprint planning conversations with Engineering.

* Analyze PI (Partner Installer) behavior patterns using Salesforce data to identify systemic risks such as production overstatement, CO circumvention, and documentation non-compliance, and recommend systemic controls.

* Participate in cross-functional project meetings (e.g., CLS issue mapping, PMO-led initiatives) and produce structured meeting notes, action item trackers, and follow-up deliverables.

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, data analytics, or a related field with a minimum of 5+ years of professional work experience in business analysis, operations analysis, management consulting, or strategy/operations role in solar finance, fintech, or financial services.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to map complex multi-step processes, identify failure points, and propose structured solutions — comfort with process flow mapping and root cause analysis.

* Proficiency in Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (structured presentations for leadership audiences).

* Excellent written communication — ability to produce clear, structured gap analysis documents, SOPs, and requirements specifications.

* Comfort working across multiple teams simultaneously (Product, Engineering, Operations, Capital Markets) in a fast-paced environment.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Experience in residential solar TPO operations, loan servicing, or asset management — familiarity with milestone-based workflows (NTP, M1, M2, M3).

* Familiarity with Salesforce as a system of record and experience pulling operational data for analysis.

* Exposure to investor reporting, capital markets due diligence, or portfolio quality analysis in a renewable energy or structured finance context.

* Experience with process improvement frameworks (Lean, Six Sigma) or project management tools (Jira, Asana, Miro).

* SQL or BI tool experience (Tableau, Looker) for operational data analysis is a plus.

new_jobs.title: Operations Analyst, User Safety & Risk Operations
new_jobs.description:
Trust & Safety - San Francisco

**About the Team**

At OpenAIs of misuse. We translate real-world user and operational signals into timely decisions, practical interventions, and improvements to our products and systems.

This role will take on new, ambiguous, or underdeveloped operational risks and help mature them into scalable capabilities. We work across USRO and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Product Policy, Legal, Safety, Support, and external vendors or partnership stakeholders.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Operations Analyst to take on complex, ambiguous safety and risk problems and turn them into practical operational solutions that can scale. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a versatile operator who is comfortable moving between queues, investigation, analysis, workflow design, hands-on execution, and cross-functional leadership. Depending on team needs, the role may focus on emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployment partnerships, or other new operational areas.

You will be expected to move quickly, work hands-on, and create structure without waiting for perfect requirements or a large support team. The work starts with the problem, not a prescribed process. You may investigate unstructured user signals, stand up a lightweight workflow, build an AI-assisted tool, improve an existing operation, or help a new launch become operationally ready. The goal is to produce durable systems that other people can run, not simply complete a series of individual tasks.

The portfolio will change with company priorities and may span established harm areas, emerging-risk incubation, cloud deployments and partnerships, device safety, or new product launches. Some hires may focus primarily on cloud deployment operations, including launch readiness, partner coordination, safety workflows, and operational monitoring. You will typically own a small number of high-impact problems at a time and will be expected to judge what needs to be built, what can stay lightweight, and when the work is ready to scale, transfer, or stop.

Location / work model: San Francisco, CA; hybrid, 3 days/week in-office.

***Please note:*** *This role may involve exposure to sensitive or concerning content. Strong discretion, good judgment, and resilience are essential.*

**In This Role, You Will**

* Take ownership of ambiguous, high-priority safety and risk problems: define the problem, gather the right evidence, choose a practical path, drive execution, and close the loop.
* Analyze structured and unstructured data, both quantitative and qualitative. This may include user reports, case narratives, conversations, escalations, and operational metrics to identify patterns, risks, and the highest-leverage interventions.
* Build and test lightweight workflows, tools, automations, and decision aids that improve speed, quality, and consistency, then iterate based on real-world use.
* Turn one-off insights and manual work into scalable operating mechanisms without adding unnecessary process or complexity.
* Lead sensitive investigations, incident response, or launch-readiness work, including safety workflows, human review, escalation paths, partner coordination, and operational monitoring for product launches or cloud deployments.
* Work directly with cross-functional and external partners to clarify ownership, resolve operational gaps, and turn incomplete signals into clear recommendations and decisions.
* Measure whether the work is improving outcomes—such as quality, speed, coverage, operator effort, or risk reduction—and adjust quickly when it is not.
* Help junior operators build judgment and independence through coaching, calibration, and reusable tools.

**You Might Thrive in This Role If You**

* Have 8+ years of experience in trust and safety operations, investigations, incident response, product operations, technical program management, or another high-judgment, data-heavy operational field.
* Have a track record as a scrappy generalist who can enter an unfamiliar problem, learn quickly, and deliver with limited structure or support.
* Are highly data savvyation and combine it with quantitative evidence.
* Are technically fluent and hands-on with AI tools, dashboards, and data tooling, and can build or prototype practical solutions without waiting for a dedicated technical team.
* Operate independently, make clear tradeoffs, and maintain momentum as priorities and requirements change.
* Think in systems: you look beyond the immediate task and build approaches that can be repeated, measured, and operated by others.
* Exercise strong judgment in sensitive situations involving user impact, policy, legal risk, technical constraints, and business priorities.
* Communicate clearly and directlyal authority.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in trust and safety, fraud, product safety, integrity, or another adversarial or high-severity risk domain.
* Experience moving a new or immature workflow from early investigation into stable, scaled operations.
* Experience supporting cloud platforms or deployment partnerships, enterprise products, product launches, connected devices, or other technically complex programs. Direct cloud experience is a plus, not a requirement.
* Familiarity with SQL, lightweight scripting, no-code tools, workflow automation, or AI-assisted development.
* Experience with vendor operations, quality programs, calibrations, or distributed operational teams.

**About OpenAI**

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

We are an equal opportunity employeration, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.
